question.text: NRIs investing in Indian AIFs are subject to provisions of:

explanation.text: The Logic: AIFs may raise funds from Indian, foreign, and NRI investors by issuing units, subject to FEMA, 1999; FEMA regulations govern AIF investments by foreign investors including NRIs and PIOs. The Trap: Restricting eligibility to the Companies Act, Income Tax Act, or Indian Trusts Act ignores the FEMA framework that specifically governs cross-border AIF investments. Note: Source pages 72 and 90 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
